mail.paste_link: Or paste this link into your browser:
verify.subject: Confirm your email address
verify.preheader: One click and your Todo account is ready.
verify.headline: Confirm your email address
verify.body: Thanks for signing up for Todo. Confirm that this address is yours, and your account is ready to use.
verify.note_expiry: This link works once and expires in 24 hours.
verify.note_ignore: If you did not create an account, ignore this email: nothing happens without the link.
verify.reason: You received this email because someone signed up for Todo with this address.
reset.subject: Reset your Todo password
reset.preheader: Choose a new password. The link expires in one hour.
reset.headline: Reset your password
reset.body: We received a request to reset the password of your Todo account. Choose a new one below; every device signed in to your account will be signed out.
reset.note_expiry: This link works once and expires in one hour.
reset.note_ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email: your password stays as it is.
reset.reason: You received this email because a password reset was requested for this address.
exists.subject: You already have a Todo account
exists.preheader: Someone tried to sign up with your address.
exists.headline: You already have an account
exists.body: Someone, hopefully you, just tried to create a Todo account with this email address. You already have one, so nothing changed.
exists.note_forgot: Forgot your password? Reset it at {url}.
exists.note_ignore: If this was not you, you can safely ignore this email.
exists.reason: You received this email because a sign-up was attempted with this address.
contact_request.subject: {actor} wants to add you as a contact
contact_request.preheader: Contacts share tasks and invite each other to groups.
contact_request.headline: {actor} wants to add you as a contact
contact_request.body: Contacts can share tasks with each other and invite each other to their groups. Accept the request to start working together.
contact_request.reason: You received this email because {actor} sent you a contact request on Todo.
contact_accepted.subject: {actor} accepted your contact request
contact_accepted.preheader: You can now share tasks with {actor}.
contact_accepted.headline: You and {actor} are now contacts
contact_accepted.body: You can now share tasks with {actor} and invite them to your groups.
contact_accepted.reason: You received this email because {actor} accepted your contact request on Todo.
invite.subject: {actor} invited you to Todo
invite.preheader: A calm, fast task list for you and the people you work with.
invite.headline: {actor} invited you to Todo
invite.body: Todo is a calm, fast task list for you and the people you work with. Create your account with this address, and {actor}’s contact request will be waiting for you.
invite.note: Not interested? Ignore this email: you will not hear from us unless someone invites you again.
invite.reason: You received this email because {actor} invited {email} to Todo.
group_invitation.subject: {actor} invited you to join {group}
group_invitation.preheader: Members of a group share one task list.
group_invitation.headline: Join {group} on Todo
group_invitation.body: {actor} invited you to join a group. Its members share a task list and see each other’s progress.
group_invitation.reason: You received this email because {actor} invited you to a group on Todo.
task_shared.subject: {actor} shared “{title}” with you
task_shared.preheader: You can now see, edit and complete it.
task_shared.headline: {actor} shared a task with you
task_shared.body: You can now see, edit and complete this task. It is in your Shared with me list.
task_shared.reason: You received this email because {actor} shared a task with you on Todo.
task_assigned.subject: {actor} assigned you “{title}”
task_assigned.preheader: It is in your Assigned to me list.
task_assigned.headline: {actor} assigned you a task
task_assigned.body: This task is now yours to do. It is in your Assigned to me list.
task_assigned.reason: You received this email because {actor} assigned you a task on Todo.
due_soon.subject: {when}: {title}
due_soon.preheader: A task you are part of is due soon.
due_soon.body: A task you own, are assigned or share is due soon.
due_soon.reason: You received this email because you own, are assigned or share this task on Todo. You get one reminder per due date.
